description: Java class implementing a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel for rendering content as text within the OFBiz framework. It handles content rendering, XML escaping, and optional edit link wrapping.

classes.name: RenderContentAsText
classes.description: A Freemarker transform class for rendering content as text, supporting optional editing links and XML escaping.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that renders content as text, handling content retrieval, XML escaping, and optional edit link wrapping.

methods.name: renderSubContent
methods.description: Performs the actual content rendering, including locale determination, XML escaping, and error handling.

methods.name: openEditWrap
methods.description: Outputs the opening HTML for an edit wrapper div.

methods.name: closeEditWrap
methods.description: Outputs the closing HTML for an edit link and wrapper div.

methods.name: getEditStyle
methods.description: Determines the CSS style class for the edit wrapper.
